text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My skin's been feeling rough lately,<n>and I think it
must be because of all<n>the tea I've been drinking.
I've<n>probably had too much caffeine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But that's why I want to go<n>strawberry picking!
Let's go and<n>replenish my vitamins!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If my skin continues to get worse...<n>Nooo, I don't
want to think about it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl seems to be<n>worried about the
condition of her<n>skin, so I get started on looking up
some good places to go strawberry<n>picking with
her.
